svg.title: A countermodel of ⊢ ¬¬(⊥ → p(a))
svg.desc: A Kripke model of 2 worlds with growing domains. An arrow points from a world to a world above it, which has every element of the world below and forces everything it forces. World 0, the model's world, has the element 0, where a = 0, and forces nothing; world 1 is above it. World 1 has the element 0, where a = 0, and forces ⊥. World 0 forces each formula left of ⊢ and not the one right of it, so ⊢ ¬¬(⊥ → p(a)) is not valid in minimal logic.
